/kick [Player name]
/ban [Player name]
/unban [Player name]
/sessionshutdown
/resetday
/memrep

games.name: Iron Man: Playground
games.desc:
Step into the suit of Ironman in this thrilling Roblox game! Fly through the skies, unleash powerful energy blasts, and take on intense battles with thugs or players. Experience the excitement of being a superhero. Whether you're battling enemies or exploring new locations, the Ironman experience brings all the action to life in an immersive Roblox world!

CONTROLS:
- G: Call Suit / Change Weapon
- E: Repulser
- Q: Secondary Weapon
- F: Hover
- Left Shift: Flight Accelerate / Sprint
- N: Eject/Send
- M: Faceplate
- Hold M: Helmet
- K: Sentry mode (ejected)
- X: Destroy Suit
- V: Flares
- B: Supersonic Flight 
- C: First Person Enable/Disable
- W/S: Speed up or speed down in flight mode

If you enjoyed the game please leave a like!👍

games.name: HCBB 9v9 2.0
games.desc:
9v9 Baseball game
Stadium Builders: Various community members

Update:
Added 1v1 game mode.

Say "set park" to change the ballpark you are in (Batting Cages only atm)
All pitches thrown fast with no drag have slight increase in speed
Batter can now right click during swing to check their swing
In VIP Servers, say "bp on" to activate Batting Practice and "bp off" to turn it off
In Batting Practice, press Spacebar to have the pitcher pitch; press 'h' to turn hints on/off; press 'b' to hide/show the strike zone
Catcher can request speed of pitch by left clicking for fast, and right clicking for slow
